This small plot of maize is important for my family. Here in the North West, the rains can be short, so I must help the soil with some fertilizer if I want a good harvest. I keep a few animals, so I also put their manure on the field before planting. I do not buy improved seed this year — I save seed from last season like my neighbors, and I will do most of the work myself with just a little help from a young man in the village during land preparation.
